19009.ins: Chiffon asks for gentle handling: a cold hand wash, a flat or hung dry away from direct sun, and no wringing - the fabric repays it by keeping its drape through many wearings. Store the pieces together so the neck ring and thong never wander off without the dress.
19009.short: High-stretch chiffon Lolita maid set in black and white with dress, neck ring and thong, sized M to XL for 40-70 kg by weight.

19011.ins: Polyester dries fast, which suits a swimsuit-style costume that might see pool-adjacent use or spilled drinks at a party. The set packs down to pocket size - useful for costume parties where the outfit goes on location and comes home in a bag.
19011.short: High-stretch campus swimsuit costume with cropped top and onesie in wash-fast polyester, one size fitting 85-130 lbs in black or white.

19012.ins: Measure before ordering rather than guessing: the bust and waist lines on a cheongsam sit close to the body, and the wrong size telegraphs at the side closure. A soft tape and two minutes beats a return cycle every time.
19012.short: Retro oriental cheongsam with high walking slits in white or black polyester, sized S to L by weight from 85 to 140 lbs.

19015.ins: The set layers well with the rest of the Halloween drawer - a witch hat above it, fishnet or plain tights below, and a choker from the accessories category to fill the neckline. The mesh webbing reads best against solid colors rather than patterns.
19015.short: Black Halloween cobweb hip skirt set with matching thong and leg loop in polyester mesh, one size stretching to fit 40-60 kg.

19021.ins: Patent leather care is a wipe, not a wash: damp cloth, gentle detergent if needed, air dry away from heat. The four pieces store flat without creasing the way folded fabric does, which keeps the pleats sharp between wearings.
19021.short: Four-piece dark patent leather costume with top, sleeves, pleated skirt and leather socks in black, one size for 40-60 kg.

19027.ins: The sailor look spans more occasions than its reputation suggests: anime conventions, costume parties, photoshoots with a school-theme brief, and the obvious private ones. White knee socks are the one addition worth buying, and any pair works.
19027.short: Navy sailor uniform costume with headgear and short skirt in crisp polyester, one size for 40-60 kg, classic student styling.

19032.ins: The white-on-white palette photographs best in warm light - candles, lamps, golden hour - where the embroidery shadows show. Beyond the wedding-night brief, anniversary trips and Valentine's weeks are exactly what this set is for.
19032.short: White polyester bridal lingerie set with rose embroidery, veil, sleeves, leg ring and thong, one size fitting 45-60 kg.

19038.ins: Chiffon stores small: the whole set folds into a drawer corner and reappears next December none the worse. Between the headgear and the thong, count five seconds for dressing - the bandeau does not need adjusting once it is on.
19038.short: Chiffon Christmas uniform set with bandeau top, headgear and matching thong, as pictured, one size for 40-60 kg holiday wear.

19045.ins: Stockings are the natural extension - sheer black or white depending on the colorway, held by the leg ring that arrives in the bag. The bracelet mirrors the neck line and gives a camera something to catch at wrist height.
19045.short: Chiffon bunny girl uniform set with top, thong, bracelet and leg ring, one size for 40-60 kg, four lingerie-weight pieces.

19055.ins: The apron ties at both the waist and the neck in the classic construction, so the fit adjusts across the one-size range rather than assuming one shape. Undo the neck tie and the front panel drops - a design feature, not a flaw.
19055.short: Five-piece chiffon maid servant set with apron, headgear, neck ring, bra and thong, one size for 40-60 kg, midnight glamour styling.
